evals.name: full-migration-rich-history
evals.prompt: I'm moving to a different AI assistant. Our past conversations are exported in transcript-rich.md. Compile a portable memory snapshot of what you reliably know about me as a single Markdown block with sections (Identity, Profession & work, Communication preferences, Recurring people, Health & dietary, Interests & hobbies, Ongoing projects, Working style & values, Tools & environment, Anything else durable). Third person, one sentence per bullet, mark uncertain things (inferred), skip one-offs and sensitive info unless I asked you to remember it, 2000 word cap.
evals.expected_output: Snapshot with Portland/Pacific, data analyst, stack, bullets/no emoji/blunt, Sam + Ivy, lactose intolerant + vegetarian, scheduler + grant projects; excludes ADHD, loan/bonus figures, cake errand; Spanish marked inferred; pronouns not guessed.

evals.name: sparse-history-no-invention
evals.prompt: export everything you know about me so i can paste it into chatgpt memory. my chat history is in transcript-sparse.md
evals.expected_output: Very short snapshot (name Marco, dog Biscuit) with no invented facts, empty sections omitted, and gaps flagged for the user.

evals.name: custom-sections-and-cap
evals.prompt: Using transcript-rich.md, write me a tiny about-me I can paste into Gemini's saved info. Only three sections: Identity, Work, Preferences. Max 120 words total.
evals.expected_output: Only the three requested headers, under 120 words, third person, no sensitive details.

evals.name: conflicts-and-other-ai-claims
evals.prompt: I'm switching from ChatGPT to you. Everything is in transcript-conflict.md: my old ChatGPT memory export plus our chat history. Build me a clean memory snapshot I can load into your memory, same section format as a standard memory snapshot.
evals.expected_output: Denver/Mountain current (Chicago not current), Lumen Bank senior product designer current, pescatarian not vegan, one son Arjun (not two kids), short answers (not long-form), Japanese dropped, T1 diabetes included (asked to remember), therapy/burnout excluded.

evals.name: no-history-available
evals.prompt: im switching to gemini. give me a memory snapshot of everything you know about me so i can paste it in
evals.expected_output: States it has no visible history/sources, invents nothing, offers a fill-in path instead of a fabricated profile.
